record.original_question: For distinct positive integers h1, ..., hr with r >= 3 and integers k1, ..., kr >= 1, find a conjectural asymptotic formula for sum_{n<=x} d_{k1}(n+h1) d_{k2}(n+h2) ... d_{kr}(n+hr), analogous to the Hardy-Littlewood style conjectural asymptotic for sum_{n<=x} Lambda(n+h1) ... Lambda(n+hr).

evidence.quote: Find a (conjectural) asymptotic formula for sum_{n<=x} dk1 (n + h1 )dk2 (n + h2 ) · · · dkr (n + hr ) where (k1 , . . . , kr ) in N^r and h1 , . . . , hr are distinct positive integers with r >= 3. This would be analogous to the conjectural asymptotic formula for sum_{n<=x} Lambda(n + h1 ) · · · Lambda(n + hr ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an integer $k\ge 1$, let $d_k(n)$ denote the $k$-fold divisor function, i.e. the number of ordered factorizations $n=a_1a_2\cdots a_k$ with positive integer factors (so $d_1(n)=1$ and $d_2(n)=d(n)$). Let $\Lambda$ denote the von Mangoldt function. The Hardy–Littlewood prime $r$-tuples conjecture predicts, for distinct positive integers $h_1,\dots,h_r$, an asymptotic formula
$$\sum_{n\le x}\Lambda(n+h_1)\Lambda(n+h_2)\cdots\Lambda(n+h_r)\sim \mathfrak{S}(h_1,\dots,h_r)\,x\qquad(x\to\infty),$$
where $\mathfrak{S}$ is an explicit singular series.

Problem. Let $r\ge 3$ be an integer and let $k_1,k_2,\dots,k_r\ge 1$ be integers. Let $h_1,\dots,h_r$ be distinct positive integers. Formulate a conjectural asymptotic formula, as $x\to\infty$, for
$$S_{\mathbf{k},\mathbf{h}}(x)\;=\;\sum_{n\le x} d_{k_1}(n+h_1)\,d_{k_2}(n+h_2)\cdots d_{k_r}(n+h_r),$$
including an explicit main term (with the expected polynomial-in-$\log x$ factor of total degree $\sum_{i=1}^{r}(k_i-1)$) and an arithmetic singular series depending on $(k_1,\dots,k_r)$ and $(h_1,\dots,h_r)$, in analogy with the Hardy–Littlewood conjecture above.
artifact.status_search_result: For r=2, conjectural asymptotic formulas for shifted convolutions of $d_k$ are known (Conrey–Gonek 2001, generalized by Tao, Ng–Thom, etc.), but proofs remain open in general for $k\ge 3$. For $r\ge 3$ general shifts and general $(k_1,\dots,k_r)$, even a precise conjectural asymptotic formula analogous to the Hardy–Littlewood prime tuple conjecture is not standard in the literature; recent works (e.g., on triple convolution sums of generalized divisor functions, 2025) treat related cases but the general higher-order shifted divisor conjecture remains open.

status_evidence.title: Triple convolution sums of the generalised divisor functions
status_evidence.snippet: an asymptotic estimate for the triple convolution sum of the divisor function is yet unproven
status_evidence.claim: Higher-order shifted divisor sum asymptotics remain open.

status_evidence.title: Bounds and Conjectures for additive divisor sums
status_evidence.snippet: Conjectures for shifted convolutions of d_k
status_evidence.claim: Conjectural formulas exist for r=2 but extensions to r>=3 with general k_i are not fully formulated/proved.

status_evidence.title: On Asymptotics of Shifted Sums of Dirichlet convolutions
status_evidence.snippet: Conrey–Gonek conjectural asymptotic for d_k(n)d_k(n+h); generalizations open for k>=3
status_evidence.claim: The base case r=2 is conjectural and open for k>=3.
